rule: Ada/Hopper (cc >= 8.9) with < 19.5 GiB -> HF FP8 W8A8 engine (engine_v4 'hf_fp8'); otherwise -> HF bf16 with batch size from a memory probe (rows x (P + max_new) x 147,456 B <= 0.8 x free VRAM). vLLM literal cell: bf16 only if the KV cache fits >= 4 sequences of 18,432 tokens, else Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8 rev 220b46e3.
consequence: bf16: iteration-4 FP8 rows cannot be reused slot for slot; T1.3, TOPK10, NOVELTY and SEMSEED are rerun on D5 (P3); everything else from iteration 4 is carried flagged 'other engine'; the engine-check difference is reported as precision sensitivity
